description: Get a recursive tree view of a SharePoint document library. Shows the full folder/file hierarchy at a glance. Useful for understanding library structure before navigating into specific folders.

folderId.description: Start from this folder ID instead of root

maxDepth.description: Max folder depth to recurse (default: 10, max: 15)

maxItemsPerLevel.description: Max items per folder level (default: 100, max: 200)

name: get_library_tree
